entries.name: Dirt
entries.description: nothing for sale, nobody has more than they need; unskilled labor is cheap

entries.name: Poor
entries.description: only the bare necessities for sale; weapons scarce unless heavily defended or militant

entries.name: Moderate
entries.description: most mundane items available, some skilled laborers

entries.name: Wealthy
entries.description: any mundane item can be found; most skilled laborers, but in demand

entries.name: Rich
entries.description: (mundane items and more, if you know where to look; specialist labor at high prices).

entries.name: Exodus
entries.description: the steading has lost its population and is on the verge of collapse

entries.name: Shrinking
entries.description: population is less than it once was; buildings stand empty

entries.name: Steady
entries.description: population in line with current size, slow growth

entries.name: Growing
entries.description: more people than buildings

entries.name: Booming
entries.description: (resources stretched thin keeping up).

entries.name: None
entries.description: clubs, torches, farming tools

entries.name: Militia
entries.description: able-bodied folk with worn weapons, no standing force

entries.name: Watch
entries.description: a few watchers who look out for trouble and summon the militia

entries.name: Guard
entries.description: armed defenders at all times, pool under 100

entries.name: Garrison
entries.description: armed defenders at all times, pool of 100–300, multiple patrols

entries.name: Battalion
entries.description: up to 1,000 armed defenders, manned maintained defenses

entries.name: Legion
entries.description: (thousands of armed soldiers, intimidating defenses).

entries.name: Safe
entries.description: outside trouble doesn't come here until the players bring it

entries.name: Religion
entries.description: a listed deity is revered here

entries.name: Exotic
entries.description: goods and services unavailable anywhere else nearby

entries.name: Resource
entries.description: easy access to a listed resource, significantly cheaper

entries.name: Need
entries.description: an acute or ongoing need for a listed resource, which sells for considerably more

entries.name: Oath
entries.description: sworn to listed steadings, generally fealty or support

entries.name: Trade
entries.description: regularly trades with listed steadings

entries.name: Market
entries.description: everyone comes here to trade; +1 to Supply

entries.name: Enmity
entries.description: holds a grudge against listed steadings

entries.name: History
entries.description: something important once happened here: battle, miracle, myth, romance, tragedy

entries.name: Arcane
entries.description: someone can cast arcane spells for a price; +1 to Recruit an adept

entries.name: Divine
entries.description: a major religious presence that can heal or raise the dead for a donation; +1 to Recruit priests

entries.name: Guild
entries.description: a listed guild type has major presence; +1 to Recruit an associated hireling

entries.name: Personage
entries.description: a notable person makes their home here

entries.name: Dwarven* / *Elven
entries.description: significantly or entirely that race; their goods more common and less expensive

entries.name: Craft
entries.description: known for excellence in a listed craft

entries.name: Lawless
entries.description: crime is rampant, authority weak

entries.name: Blight
entries.description: a recurring problem, usually a type of monster

entries.name: Power
entries.description: (holds sway of some type — political, divine, or arcane).
